decisions.rationale: Captain decision pep-fast-project-block, option A: plan one cumulative reusable Python project for FT9, FT10 and FT11, with one teach-before-apply increment per Fast day. Each increment has observable outcomes and a starter scaffold or extension, plus public language-native tests run with one command (pytest or python -m unittest). Use the program's Fast pattern: inside each 70-minute increment, every applied concept gets a short minuted embedded teach-then-check step before its first use; the Skim and the topic pages are reference; each Fast day fits its frozen 120-minute template, otherwise narrow the increment. Claim per-requirement coverage only (compound objectives partly covered stay owned by their topic pages). Reuse Standard Python lab scaffolds and tests where skills match, but present the activity as a project increment, never a coding lab. No containers; solutions, hidden tests and private checkpoints never enter the repository.
